captions.text: Moses
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: The next day I rejoined my interlocutor, and he continued his account: In Genesis, 28, there is another description of our presence.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: And behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of Elohim ascending and descending on it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But men, having fallen back into a very primitive state after the destruction of the most intelligent and of centers of progress like Sodom and Gomorrah, began stupidly to worship pieces of stone and idols, forgetting who had created them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Put away the strange gods that are among you
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In Exodus we appear to Moses:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And the angel of Yahweh appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A rocket landed before him, and the description he gives corresponds to the one a primitive man from Brazil would give today if we landed there, in this craft whose white light shines among the trees without setting them ablaze for all that…
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The chosen people, being the most intelligent people, had been beheaded of its most brilliant minds and had become the slave of the neighboring primitive peoples, who were far more numerous because they had not undergone great destructions.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It was therefore necessary to give this people back its dignity by giving it back its country.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Exodus describes, at the beginning, everything we had to do so that the people of Israel would be freed.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When they set out, we guided them to the country we intended for them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And Yahweh went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: To slow the march of the Egyptians launched in pursuit of them:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And the pillar of the cloud removed from before them, and stood behind them the cloud was (for the one) darkness, and (for the other) it gave light by night.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The smoke emitted behind the people of Israel made a curtain that slowed the pursuers.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Then the crossing of the water is obtained by means of a repelling ray that allows a passage to be cleared.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Thus Yahweh saved Israel that day
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Then, across the desert, hunger made itself felt among the chosen people:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: upon the face of the wilderness there lay a small round thing
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The manna was merely a synthetic chemical food sprayed onto the surface of the ground, which the morning dew caused to swell.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: As for the staff of Moses that allowed him to bring water out, it was merely a detector of underground water tables, similar to those you currently use to find oil, for example.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Once the water is located, one need only dig.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Then, in chapter 19 of Exodus, a certain number of rules are set out.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The people of Israel, given their primitive level, needed laws on the moral plane and especially on the hygienic plane.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They are set out in the commandments.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The creators came to dictate these laws to Moses on Mount Sinai.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They came down in a flying craft:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because Yahweh descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder,.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But the creators were afraid of being invaded or jostled by men; they had to be respected, even venerated, so as not to be in danger.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The people cannot come up to mount Sinai let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto Yahweh, lest he break forth upon them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And Moses alone shall come near Yahweh: but the elders of Israel shall not come near; neither shall the people go up with him!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And they saw the God of Israel: and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: There you have a description of the pedestal on which one of the creators showed himself and which was made of the same bluish alloy as the floor of the craft where we are at present.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: the sight of the glory of Yahweh was like devouring fire on the top of the mount.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: There you have the description of the glory — in reality the flying craft — of the creators, and as you have been able to notice, at the moment of departure it takes on a coloring similar to that of fire.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This team of creators was going to reside for a time on Earth and wanted fresh food; this is why it asked that the people of Israel give it some regularly, as well as riches to bring back afterward to its planet.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It was a bit of colonization, if you like.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Of every man ye shall take an offering for me gold, and silver, and brass, (precious) stones, etc.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They had also decided to settle more comfortably and asked men to fashion a residence for them according to their plans.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This is what is dictated in chapter 26 of Exodus.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In this residence they were to meet the representatives of men: it is the tent of meeting, where men brought food and presents as a pledge of submission.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He would enter into the tent of meeting.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And it came to pass, as Moses entered into the tent, the cloudy pillar descended, and stood at the door of the tent.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And He talked with Moses.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And Yahweh spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend…
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Just as today I can speak to you and you can speak to me, man to man.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: There you have the allusion to the difference of atmosphere existing between our planets.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A man cannot see his creators unless the latter are protected by a suit, the terrestrial atmosphere not being suited to them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If man came to our planet, he would see the creators there without a suit, but he would die because the atmosphere does not suit him.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The whole beginning of Leviticus explains how the foods offered to the creators must be brought for their provisioning.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For example in 21, 17-18:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish, he shall not approach to offer the food of his God.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This, evidently, in order to prevent sick or deformed men, symbols of a failure and unbearable in the eyes of the creators, from presenting themselves before them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You have in Numbers, 11, 7-8, the very exact description of the manna that your chemists could reconstitute.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And the manna was as coriander seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium and the taste of it was as the taste of a delicacy made with oil.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But this manna was merely a chemical food which the creators preferred to fresh fruits and vegetables.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The firstfruits of all that shall be in their land, which they shall bring unto Yahweh.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Further on, the creators teach men to give injections against snakebites.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: As soon as a man was bitten, he looked at the serpent of brass; a syringe was brought near him, and he was given an injection of serum.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Finally comes the end of the journey that leads the chosen people into the promised land.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: On the creators' advice, they destroy the idols of the primitive tribes and occupy their territories.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Ye shall destroy all their molten images and ye shall possess the land.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The chosen people at last had its promised country:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For the crossing of the Jordan, in Joshua, 3, 15-16:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: as soon as the bearers of the ark were come the waters which came down from above stood and rose up upon an heap a great way off the waters were wholly cut off, and the people passed over
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The creators made the chosen people pass over dry-shod, as during the flight from the Egyptians, using the same repelling ray.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The Trumpets of Jericho
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: At the end of Joshua, V, there is a contact between a creator-soldier and the chosen people before the resistance of a city: Jericho.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I am the captain of the host of Yahweh, I am now come!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For the siege of Jericho, a military adviser is sent to the Jewish people.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You will very easily understand how the walls collapsed.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You know that a singer with a very high-pitched voice can make a crystal glass crack.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Well, by using greatly amplified ultrasound, one can make any concrete wall collapse.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This is what was done thanks to a very complicated instrument that the Bible calls a trumpet.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When they make a long blast with the ram's horn, and when ye hear the sound of the trumpet the wall of the city shall fall down flat.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: At a precise moment, the ultrasound is emitted in a synchronized way and the wall collapses.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A little later, it is a veritable bombardment that is carried out:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Yahweh cast down great stones from heaven upon them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They were more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Israel slew with the sword.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A regular bombardment that killed more people than the bladed weapons of the people of Israel.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: One of the most distorted passages is the one where it is said, still in Joshua,:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And the sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Which simply means that the war was a lightning war that lasted only a day, since it is said further on that it lasted about a whole day.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This war was so short in relation to the extent of the terrain conquered that men believed the sun had stopped…
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In Judges, 6, one of the creators is again in contact with a man named Gideon who hands him food.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: the angel of Yahweh put forth the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the flesh and the unleavened cakes; and there rose up fire out of the rock, and consumed the flesh and the unleavened cakes; then the angel of Yahweh departed.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: By a scientific means, the creators, who cannot eat in the open air because of their suits, can if need be use the various offerings to extract the essential from them, which, by means of a flexible tube, a staff, reaches them to feed them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This operation gives off flames that make the men of that time believe it is a matter of sacrifices to God.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In Judges, 7, the 300 men who surround an enemy camp with trumpets and sound them all together to drive the men mad use instruments emitting greatly amplified ultrasound.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You now know that certain sounds pushed to the extreme can drive any man mad.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Indeed, the encircled people goes mad, the soldiers kill one another and take flight.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Samson the telepath
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: As for the matings between the creators and the wives of men, you have yet another example in Judges, 13:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And the angel of Yahweh appeared unto the woman, and said unto her: behold now, thou art barren.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But thou shalt conceive, and bear a son.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It was necessary that the fruit of this union be healthy in order to observe its behavior; this is why he said to her:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Beware now, drink not wine nor strong drink,
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: for, lo, thou shalt bear a son.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: No razor shall come on his head: for the child shall be a Nazarite unto God from the womb.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: the angel of Elohim came again unto the woman, while
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: her husband was not with her.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You can easily imagine what may have happened in the husband's absence…
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It was easy for the scientists to remove this woman's barrenness so that she would clearly realize she was bringing an exceptional being into the world and would take the greatest care of it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For the creators to mate with a daughter of men was magnificent.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It allowed them to have sons reigning directly on Earth, in this atmosphere that did not suit them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Regarding the matter of not shaving the hair, this is very important.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The brain of man is like a large transmitter capable of sending out a multitude of very clear waves and thoughts.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Telepathy is in fact nothing else.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But this kind of transmitter needs antennas.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The antennas are the hair and the beard.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Hence the importance of not shaving the hair system of a being who will have to use it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You have surely noticed that many of your scientists had very long hair and often a beard; likewise the prophets and the sages.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You understand better now why.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This child was born: it was Samson, whose story you know.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He could communicate with God directly by telepathy thanks to his natural antennas: his hair.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And the creators could then come to his aid in difficult moments or to perform wonders reinforcing his authority.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But when Delilah had cut his hair, he could no longer call for help.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He then had his eyes put out by his enemies, but when his hair had grown back, he recovered his strength — that is, he could call to his aid the creators, who made collapse the temple whose columns he was touching.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This was attributed to the strength of Samson…
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In I Samuel, 3, you have a veritable initiation into telepathy, by Eli upon Samuel: the creators seek to enter into contact with Samuel, and the latter believes it is Eli speaking to him.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He hears voices:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Go, lie down: and it shall be, if he call thee, that thou shalt say, Speak, Yahweh; for thy servant heareth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Somewhat like radio amateurs, one of whom would say: speak, I read you loud and clear.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And the telepathic conversation begins:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Samuel, Samuel!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Speak, Yahweh; for thy servant heareth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In the episode of David against Goliath you have yet another interesting little phrase:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Who defy the armies of the living God?
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Which clearly shows the reality of the presence, at that time, of a quite palpable God…
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Telepathy as a means of communication between the creators and men was possible only when the Elohim were in proximity to Earth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When they were on their distant planet or elsewhere, they could not correspond by this means.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This is why they installed a transmitter-receiver that was carried in the ark of God, a transmitter-receiver that had its own atomic battery.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This is why in I Samuel, V, 1-5, when the Philistines stole the ark of God, their idol, Dagon, lay face down on the ground before the ark of Yahweh, following an electrical discharge caused by mishandling.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Moreover, the dangerous radiation of the radioactive products caused them burns.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He smote them with emerods.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Even the Jews who took no precautions in handling the ark of God were affected:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Uzzah put forth (his hand) to the ark of God, and took hold of it, for the oxen shook it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And the anger of Yahweh was kindled against Uzzah; and God smote him there for his error: and there he died by the ark of God.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The ark had nearly tipped over and Uzzah, trying to hold it back, had touched a dangerous part of the apparatus.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He had been electrocuted.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In I Kings, it is said several times: He caught hold on the horns of the altar., which is the description of the handling of the levers of the transmitter-receiver to try to enter into contact with the creators.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The first residence for the reception of the Elohim
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: The great king Solomon had built on Earth a sumptuous residence to receive the creators when they came on a visit.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Yahweh said that he would dwell in a cloud.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I have surely built thee an house to dwell in.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The glory of Yahweh had filled the house of Yahweh.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The cloud filled the house of Yahweh.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I will dwell among the children of Israel.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: That he dwells in a cloud — that is, in a craft in orbit around the Earth, above the clouds… but go and make that understood to primitive men.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: by the word of Yahweh, a man of God came from Judah to Bethel and he said behold, the altar shall be rent Jeroboam put forth his hand saying, Lay hold on him! but the hand which he put forth dried up, so that he could not pull it in again to him, the altar also was rent
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: By means of an atomic disintegrator, one of the creators destroys the altar and burns the hand of one of the men who did not respect the creators.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He leaves again toward one of the terrestrial camps of the Elohim by a different route so that men cannot discover them:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Thou shalt not return by the way that thou camest.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: So he went another way.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: An example of the remote guidance of animals by electrode, as you are beginning to discover, is given in I Kings, 17-6:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning and in the evening.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The creators, who have decided to appear as seldom as possible because of recent discoveries, and not to influence the destiny of man too much in order to see whether he will reach the scientific era on his own, increasingly use discreet means of communication with men, like this way of provisioning Elijah by carrier ravens.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is the beginning of a gigantic experiment on a galactic scale among several competing humanities.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The creators decide to show themselves less, while reinforcing the authority and renown of their ambassadors, the prophets, by the accomplishment of miracles — that is, the use of scientific means incomprehensible at the time.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: See!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Thy son liveth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Now by this I know that thou art a man of God.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Elijah had treated and healed a dying young child.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He then has two young bulls placed on pyres at Mount Carmel: one consecrated to an idol, Baal, the other to the creators.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The one that lights by itself will represent the only true God to have.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Evidently, at the moment agreed in advance between Elijah and the creators, the pyre destined for them lit up, even when flooded, thanks to a powerful ray close to a laser and emitted from a ship hidden in the clouds.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And the fire of Yahweh fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Elijah the messenger
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Elijah was the object of eager attentions on the part of the creators.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: an angel touched him, and said unto him, Arise and eat! at his head there was a cake and a cruse of water.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This takes place in the middle of the desert…
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And, behold, Yahweh passed by.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A great and strong wind rent the mountains and brake in pieces the rocks before Yahweh; but Yahweh was not in the wind.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And after the wind an earthquake.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And after the earthquake a fire; but Yahweh was not in the fire.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And after the fire a still small voice.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: There you have the exact description of the landing of a craft comparable to your present-day rockets.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Further on, he describes the vision of the creators.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I saw Yahweh sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The creators again make use of telepathy, but of group telepathy, so that none of the prophets predicts the truth to the king.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In 2 Kings, I-12 you have yet again proof of the protection that the creators grant to Elijah:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If I be a man of God, let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty men and the fire of God came down from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty men
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This operation occurred again, but the third time:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: the angel of Yahweh said unto Elijah: Go down with him: be not afraid of him!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In 2 Kings, 2 Elijah is the guest of the creators in a spaceship that takes off and carries him away.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When Yahweh would take up Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: behold, there appeared a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, and parted them both asunder (between Elijah and Elisha): and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is the takeoff of a flying craft, and the fire of the nozzles makes the narrator speak of horses of fire.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If today you take primitive people from South America or black Africa and have them witness the takeoff of a rocket, they speak of a chariot of fire and horses of fire when they return to their tribes, incapable of understanding, even broadly, scientific phenomena in a rational way, and seeing in this the supernatural, the mystical, and the Divine.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Further on Elisha, like his father, proceeds to a resurrection.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He treats and brings back to life a dead child.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A very common thing nowadays, where mouth-to-mouth and heart massage are regularly performed to bring back to life a being whose cardiac muscle has stopped.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Elisha then proceeds to the multiplication of the loaves.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The multiplication of the loaves
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: And a man brought the man of God twenty loaves of barley.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And his servant said, How should I set this before an hundred persons?
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They shall eat, and shall leave thereof.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He set it before them, and they did eat, and left thereof, according to the word of Yahweh.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The creators here bring a synthetic and dehydrated food which, with water added, corresponds to five times more volume.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: With twenty small loaves, there is enough food for a hundred men.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You already know the small vitamin pills on which your first cosmonauts feed.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It takes up little room but contains all the elements necessary for nutrition.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In one pill there is enough to feed one man; in a volume equivalent to a small loaf: five men; in twenty small loaves there is enough to feed a hundred men.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But the people of Israel worshipped metal idols, was anthropophagous, and became completely immoral, disgusting those who had created it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: and Israel was carried away out of their own land
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This is the beginning of the dispersion of the people of Israel, whose civilization, instead of progressing, was in constant regression, contrary to its neighbors, who profited from it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In the book of Isaiah, you find further:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw Adonai sitting upon a throne, high.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Seraphim stood above him: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: There you have the description of the creators clad in an autonomous suit fitted with six small thrusters: two on the back, two at the hands, and two at the feet, the latter directional.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, like as of a great people!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Yahweh of hosts mustereth the host of the battle.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They come from a far country, from the end of heaven, even Yahweh, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The whole truth is described here.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: One had to read between the lines and understand.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They come from a far country, from the end of heaven.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: One could not be clearer.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: An allusion to the vanished scientists who had acquired enough scientific knowledge to undertake to go to the planet of the creators and were destroyed at Sodom and Gomorrah.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The host of heaven is described here at that time, at the moment when it comes, with the weapons of its indignation, to destroy the whole land.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is the men of Sodom and Gomorrah who said:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I will ascend above the heights of the cloud, I will be like the
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Most High.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But the destruction prevented man from equaling the creators, the Most High.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He made the world as a wilderness.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The nuclear explosion is described further on:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The cry is gone round about the borders of Moab; the howling thereof unto Eglaim, the howling thereof unto Beer-elim.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For the waters of Dimon shall be full of blood!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Some, however, were saved by sheltering in blockhouses.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Ezekiel's flying saucers
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: But it is in Ezekiel that the most interesting description of one of our flying craft is found:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: a great cloud, and a fire infolding itself, and a brightness was about it, and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Also out of the midst thereof came the likeness of four living creatures, whose appearance was thus: they had the likeness of a man.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And every one had four faces, and every one had four wings.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And their feet: the foot was straight, and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf's foot, and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Their wings were joined one to another for all four.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: As for the likeness of their faces, they had the face of a man, and the face of a lion, on the right side of the four; and the face of an ox on the left side of the four; and the face of an eagle for the four.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Their wings were stretched upward; two wings of every one were joined one to another, and two covered their bodies.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And every one went straight forward according to the orientation of his face.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They went where the spirit was to go.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They turned not when they went.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: As for the likeness of the living creatures, the vision was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches; it went up and down among the living creatures; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Now as I beheld the living creatures, behold one wheel upon the earth by the living creatures, with his four faces.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The appearance of the wheels was like unto the colour of a beryl: and they four had one likeness: and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When they went, they went upon their four sides: and they turned not when they went.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: As for their rings, they were so high that they were dreadful and their rings were full of eyes round about them four.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went by them: and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Whithersoever the spirit was to go, they went, and the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When those went, these went; and when those stood, these stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And the likeness of the firmament upon the heads of the living creature was as the colour of the terrible crystal, stretched forth over their heads above.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And under the firmament their wings were straight, the one toward the other: every one had two, which covered their bodies.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And when they went, I heard the noise of their wings, like the noise of great waters, as the voice of Shaddai, the noise of speech, as the noise of an host.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When they stood, they let down their wings.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And there was a voice from above the firmament that was over their heads.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone: and upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: There is a description, as precise as can be, of the creators come down from their flying craft.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The great cloud is the trail that aircraft leave at very high altitude nowadays; then the craft appears with its blinking lamp, the fire infolding itself and the colour of amber.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Four creators then move about with antigravitational suits and small directional thrusters.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Wings on their metallic suits: their feet… sparkled like the colour of burnished brass.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You have been able to notice that the suits of your cosmonauts are very shiny.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: As for the flying saucer, the wheel, their appearance and their functioning are not too badly described, knowing that it is a primitive man speaking.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: As it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel they turned not when they went.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: At the center of the flying saucers, very close in appearance to the one in which we find ourselves, is located the habitable part: the ring: as for their rings, they were full of eyes round about them four.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Just as our clothing has evolved and we no longer wear those cumbersome suits now, our craft were fitted with portholes, the eyes of the rings, because we had not yet found the means of seeing through the metallic walls by modifying their atomic structures at will.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The flying saucers stay near the creators, to help them in case of need, for they are busy procuring various materials and carrying out some maintenance maneuvers on the large intergalactic ship situated above them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Other creators, inside the craft, steer them: the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Evidently.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The suit is also described with its four portholes comparable to those of your first marine suits: every one had four faces.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Their faces turned not when they went.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The small saucers are a bit like service LEMs, small vehicles with a limited range used for short exploration missions.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Higher up waits the large interplanetary vehicle: And the likeness of the firmament upon the heads of the living creature was as the colour of the terrible crystal.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone: and upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This last one, on the large ship, supervised and coordinated the work of the creators.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Ezekiel, frightened, flattened himself face down on the ground before all these things, so mysterious that they can only come from God, but one of the creators said to him:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Son of man, stand upon thy feet, and I will speak unto thee hear what I say unto thee and eat that I give thee.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is an image similar to eating of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is in fact a matter of intellectual food.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is moreover a book that is given:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: behold, an hand was sent unto me; and, lo, the roll of a book was therein and it was written within and without.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It was written recto-verso, a surprising thing to read at the time when one wrote on only one side of parchments.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The scroll is then eaten — that is, Ezekiel takes cognizance of it, and what he learns, what you are learning about the origin of men, is so exciting and comforting that he says: Then did I eat it; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Then Ezekiel is transported by the creators' ship to the place where he must spread the news:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The spirit lifted me up; it took me away I heard behind me a voice of a great rushing.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Further on, the prophet is again taken away in a flying craft:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: the spirit lifted me up between earth and heaven, and brought me to
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Jerusalem.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Ezekiel then notices that under their wings, the cherubim have hands like men:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And there appeared in the cherubim the form of a man's hand under their wings.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And the cherubim, when they departed, lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight, and the wheels also beside them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The spirit lifted me up, and brought me.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And the glory of Yahweh went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And the spirit took me up, and brought me into Chaldea.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: So many journeys for Ezekiel in one of the creators' flying craft.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Yahweh brought me out and set me down in the midst of the valley.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: There, a miracle is going to take place.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The creators are going to resurrect men of whom only bones remain.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: As previously, in each particle of a living being there is all the information necessary for the reconstitution of the whole being.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: One need only place one of these particles, which can come from bone debris, in an apparatus that supplies all the living matter necessary for the reconstitution of the original being.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The machine supplies the matter, the particle gives the information, the plans according to which the being is to be constituted.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: As a spermatozoon possesses all the information to create a living being down to the color of its hair or its eyes.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Son of man, can these bones live? there was a noise, and behold a shaking the sinews and the flesh came up upon (the bones), and he covered them with skin above they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: All this is very easy to accomplish and you will do it one day.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Hence the usefulness of the very ancient rite of making the best-protected possible burials of great men, who may one day be brought back to life in this way, and that in a perpetual manner.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is part of the secret of the tree of life of eternity.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Ezekiel is again taken away by a flying craft that leads him near a man clad in a suit, in chapter 40:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He brought me and set me down upon a very high mountain, by which was as the frame of a city on the south (there was) a man, whose appearance was like the appearance of brass.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This city is one of the terrestrial bases that the creators had at that time, always on high mountains so as not to be importuned by men.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The man with the appearance of brass is of course clad in a metallic suit… just as, because of our small size, we are taken for children, for cherubim…
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The priests charged with the service of the creators in their terrestrial residence, the temple that Ezekiel visits, had aseptic garments to perform their service, and these garments had to remain in the temple so as not to risk bringing back germs dangerous to the creators:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When the priests go forth, they shall leave there the garments wherein they minister, for they are holy.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They should have written for these garments are healthful HEALTHFUL.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A subtlety incomprehensible to primitives deifying everything that was said or shown to them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In chapter 43, the large ship respectfully called the glory of God approaches:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east: and his voice was like a noise of many waters: and the earth shined with his glory.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Only the prince has the right to come and converse with the creators:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This gate shall be shut, it shall not be opened, and no man shall enter in by it; because Yahweh, the God of Israel, hath entered in by it: therefore it shall be shut.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They did not want to be disturbed.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is for the prince; the prince, he shall sit in it to eat bread before Yahweh.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But the prince had to come through an airlock where he was sterilized by means of special rays:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate, and shall go out by the way of the same.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The Levite priests are there to ensure the service of the creators:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They shall come near to me to minister unto me, and they shall stand before me to offer unto me the fat and the blood they shall come near to my table, to minister unto me.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments they shall not gird themselves with any thing that causeth sweat.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The smell of the sweat of the men of Earth was very disagreeable to them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The first of all the firstfruits of all things, and the first of your dough, ye shall give unto the priests, that the blessing may rest in thine house.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The provisioning of the creators with fresh products continued thus.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In the third chapter of Daniel, King Nebuchadnezzar has condemned three men to be thrown onto a pyre for not having wanted to worship a metal God in place of the creators, of whose existence they knew.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But the three men are saved by one of the creators who comes to their aid in the furnace, and who, by means of a repelling and refrigerating ray, drives back the heat and the flames from around them and allows them to come out without having suffered in the least:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt; and the form of the fourth is like a son of the gods.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Further on, Daniel is cast into the lions' den, but the latter do not touch him.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: There, nothing very complicated, only a small paralyzing ray, the time it takes to get Daniel out of the den.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: My God hath sent his angel, and hath shut the lions' mouths.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In the tenth chapter of Daniel you have yet another interesting description of a creator:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Then I lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a certain man.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: His body also was like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as lamps of fire, and his arms and his feet like in colour to polished brass, and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The Last Judgment
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: If the Jewish people was dominated by the Persians and by the Greeks, it is because the creators, to punish it for its lack of faith, placed men of theirs, angels, among these peoples, in order to have them accomplish technical progress explaining the great moments of their civilizations.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The angel Michael was the head of the delegation charged with helping the Persians:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Michael came there, beside the kings of Persia.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In chapter 12 of Daniel, resurrection is spoken of again:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The Last Judgment will allow great men to live again.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Those who have been positive for humanity and who have believed in the creators, followed their commandments, will be welcomed with joy by the men of the time when this happens.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: On the other hand, all the wicked men will be ashamed before their judges, but will live in eternal regret as an example for humanity.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The geniuses will be the most esteemed and the most rewarded, and the just men, having allowed the geniuses to flourish or the truth to triumph, will likewise be rewarded.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But thou, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: These words can in fact be understood only when man has reached a sufficient level of scientific knowledge — that is, now.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And all this will come to pass:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When he shall have accomplished to scatter the power of the holy people.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When the people of Israel recovers its country after the long dispersion.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The state of Israel was created some decades ago, at the same time as the scientific explosion of the men of Earth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Go thy way, Daniel: for the words are closed up and sealed till the time of the end.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: All this can be understood only at that time.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Now, all this can be understood.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For some years, scientific progress has been such, with notably the beginnings for man of space exploration, that everything seems possible, and rightly so, in the eyes of men.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Nothing any longer astonishes people who are used to seeing any wonder unfold before them on their television screens.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They can, without great astonishment, learn that they are really made in the image of God, their all-powerful creator, even in their scientific possibilities.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The miracles become comprehensible.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In Jonah, the great fish that swallows the prophet is very interesting.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Once Jonah is thrown into the sea, from the small boat:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Yahweh prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A great fish… in reality a submarine such as you now know them, but which, for the men of the time, could only be a great fish, even though the gastric juices of such a fish would have very quickly digested a man with no hope of return to the open air.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It would moreover have had to do aerophagia for the man to breathe in it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In this submarine, the creators can converse with Jonah and keep informed of the evolution of the political events of the time.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And Yahweh spake unto the fish, and it vomited out
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Jonah upon the dry land.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The submarine approached near the shore and Jonah returned to dry land.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In Zechariah V, there is again the description of a flying craft:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Then I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a flying roll the length thereof twenty cubits
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: (9 meters) and the breadth thereof ten cubits (4.50 meters).
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A little further on, the women of the creators appear for the first time:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: and, behold, there came out two women, and the wind was in their wings; for they had wings like the wings of a stork.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Two female companions of the creators equipped with autonomous flight suits move about before Zechariah.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In Psalms 8, it is said, speaking of man: Thou hast made him a little lower than the Elohim.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Men are almost as strong, intellectually, as their creators.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Those who copied did not dare write, equal to the Elohim, as had been dictated.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: his going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it…
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The creators came from a planet very far from the terrestrial orbit.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun upon the sea.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A fresh allusion to the mass of earth that was created when the ocean covered the Earth and formed the original continent.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Yahweh looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The creators watch from their flying craft over the doings of humanity, as they have always done.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Satan
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: In Job I, you have the explanation of what Satan was.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Now there was a day when the sons of Elohim came to present themselves before Yahweh, and Satan came also among them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Elohim, that means literally those come from the sky in Hebrew.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The sons of Elohim, therefore the creators who watch over men, regularly make reports on their planet of origin, showing for the most part that men venerate and love them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But one of them, named Satan, is among those who have always condemned the creation of other intelligent beings on a planet as close as Earth, seeing in it a possible threat.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: So, before the devotion of Job, one of the finest examples of a man loving his creators, he says:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Then Satan answered Yahweh, and said: Doth Job fear Elohim for nought? put forth thine hand now, and touch all that he hath.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He will surely curse thy face!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And Yahweh said unto Satan: Behold, all that he hath is in thy power; only upon himself put not forth thine hand!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The government, before the assertion of Satan, who says that Job, if he were not extremely rich, would not love his creators, gives full powers to Satan so that he ruins Job.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It will then be seen whether he still venerates his creators.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: That is why he must not be killed.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Before the obstinacy of Job, once ruined, in respecting his creators, the government triumphs over the opposition: Satan.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But the latter answers that he has lost many things but is still in good health.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The government gives him carte blanche on condition that he not kill him:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Behold, he is in thine hand; but save his life!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Still in the book of Job, a little phrase in chapter
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: 37 is interesting:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: hast thou with him spread out the sky, which is strong, and as a molten looking glass?
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Is man capable of making solid clouds, in reality metallic flying craft.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The men of the time think this is impossible for any but God.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Yet it exists nowadays…
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Finally, before the humility of Job, the creators heal him and give him back wealth, children, and health.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Men could not understand
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: In Tobit, one of the creators' robots, named Raphael, also comes to test the reactions of humans toward them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And he then departs again, after having proved to them who he was.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: All these days I did appear unto you; but I did neither eat nor drink I go up to him that sent me; but write all things which are done in a book.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: All this is easy to see in the writings.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: One still has to try to understand.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: What wisdom is, and how she came up, I will tell you, and will not hide secrets from you: but will seek her out from the beginning of her nativity, and bring the knowledge of her into light, and will not pass over the truth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When the time has come, wisdom, the science that allowed all this to exist, will be known to man in due time.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The biblical writings will be the proof of all this.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For by the greatness and beauty of the creatures proportionably the maker of them is seen.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It was nevertheless simple to see the truth, to recognize the creators by observing the created thing.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Neither by considering the works did they acknowledge the workmaster he that is.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In order not to be disturbed by men, the creators had bases on the high mountains, where traces of high civilizations are now found (Himalaya, Peru, etc.) and also at the bottom of the seas.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Progressively the high-mountain bases were abandoned to give place to submarine bases, less accessible to men.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The creators banished at the beginning hid under the oceans:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In that day Yahweh with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish Leviathan the piercing serpent, and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The government of the planet wanted at that time to destroy the creators of men.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It was not easy to see clearly in all these marvels, and one necessarily deified the creators in an abstract way, because one was incapable of understanding scientific things:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: the writing is delivered to one that is not learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee; and he saith, I am not learned.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For a long time men have had the truth in their hands, but they could not understand it before knowing how to read, being sufficiently evolved scientifically.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Every man is brutish in his knowledge.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This science which allowed the creators to create and will allow men to do the same:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Yahweh possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works of old.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth was.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When he prepared the heavens, I was there when he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights were with the sons of men.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Intelligence and science: it is thanks to these two virtues that the creators were able to create the dry land, the single continent, and the living beings they put upon it, and now this intelligence and this spirit lead the brain of man to a recommencement of the acts of their creators.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Since the beginning of time it is thus: men create other men, similar to themselves, on other worlds.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The cycle continues.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Some die, others take over.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We are your creators, and you will create other men.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: That which hath been is now; and that which is to be hath already been.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A man hath no preeminence above a beast: for all is vanity.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The animals too were created and will be recreated.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Just like man, neither more nor less.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The species that disappear will be able to live again when you know how to recreate them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We the creators do not want to show ourselves officially unless man is grateful to us for having created him.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We are afraid of a resentment that we would not admit.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We would like to enter into contact with you and have you benefit from our considerable scientific advance.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If we were sure that you would not turn against us, and that you loved us like fathers.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker!…
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What makest thou? thy work hath no value!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Woe unto him that saith unto his father, What hast thou begotten?
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For mine own sake… have I done it!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is in the fear that men do not love their creators that they let them make scientific progress all alone, almost without helping them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The emblem you see engraved on this craft and on my suit represents the truth: it is also the emblem of the Jewish people: the Star of David, which means As it is above, so it is below, and at its center the swastika, which means that everything is cyclical, the high becoming low and the low becoming high.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The origins and the destiny of the creators and of men are alike and linked.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Have ye not known? have ye not heard? hath it not been told you from the beginning? have ye not understood from the foundations of the earth?
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The trace of the creators' bases on the high mountains is found in Amos:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He… that treadeth upon the high places of the earth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The bases of the creators were seven in number:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Those seven; they are the eyes of Yahweh, which run to and fro through the whole earth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Hence the seven-branched candlestick, whose meaning was lost and which originally was, at the HQ of the creators, a central console with seven indicator lights allowing them to remain in contact with the other bases and with the interplanetary craft in orbit around the Earth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Concerning the allusion to telepathy:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For there is not a word in my tongue, but, lo, Yahweh, thou knowest it altogether.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Telepathy is unimaginable at that time: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Just as astronomy and interplanetary travel were unimaginable too:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Telecommunication either could not be understood at that time:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth: his word runneth very swiftly.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We come to the decisive turning point of the creators' work as to its orientation.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They then decide to let men progress scientifically without ever again intervening directly, having understood that they themselves were created in the same way and that, by creating beings similar to themselves, they allowed the cycle to continue.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But before, so that the truth would spread through the whole world, they decide to send a Messiah who will be capable of bringing it about that what only the people of Israel knows spreads over the whole Earth, in view of the day of the revelation of the original mystery, in the light of scientific progress.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They then announce him:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Bethlehem out of thee shall… come forth he that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And he shall stand and feed by the strength of Yahweh unto the ends of the earth, and this man shall be the Peace.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Rejoice O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee lowly, and riding upon an ass he shall speak peace unto the nations: and his dominion shall be from sea even to sea.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A symbol that Raël saw represented on the flying saucer in 1973.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is composed of two interlocking triangles (the Star of David) and a swastika at its center.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This symbol signifies that what is above is like what is below and that everything is cyclical.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The Star of David represents infinity in space, the infinitely large and the infinitely small, and the swastika represents infinity in time.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is certainly the most ancient symbol to have appeared on our planet, precisely because it is the symbol of the extraterrestrial civilization of the Elohim, who created all life on Earth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh
